decisions.label: ruling 6

create_canonical_exercise anti-dup gate: refuse on exact hit; require confirmed_new for non-exact candidates
Creation id CANONICAL:ARNOLD:<SLUG>, no silent suffixing, links required, zero-link result is hard error

decisions.gist: Every resolved none must end in alias write-back, new canonical, or logged decision; otherwise a defect
Enforcement locus is session-close check in workout-logging skill; resolver-side tracker rejected for now
Operator looks up unambiguous common movements and writes back; reserve Brock for genuinely ambiguous cases

update_canonical_exercise is sanctioned update path; cannot write source, sources append-only, omitted fields untouched
Structural edits ARNOLD-only; text enrichment allowed on any node including frozen imports
ADR-012 applies to create and update: read-back inside transaction, failed assertion rolls back
Property-drift cleanup is a separate audit task; description backfill on demand only
Namespace freeze table: ARNOLD forward; FFDB and EXERCISE frozen, aliasable, never extended
Fuzzy auto-accept in resolve_exercises is retired
log_workout auto-trust and CUSTOM orphan creation retired; unresolved exercises return clarification without writing
This document is the contract; future sessions read it instead of re-deriving
Hard rule: no imputation; fields hold only observed or explicitly stated values
session_rpe is whole-workout Foster CR10, scale 0-10, halves allowed

Never mix sets.rpe and workouts.session_rpe in one aggregate
sets.rpe is a CLOSED historical era; no capture surface for per-set RPE anywhere
Existing 430 sets.rpe values kept; amend_workout is correction path, not capture path
sets.rir values carry rir_anchor = technical_failure_90pct
RIR anchored to technical failure (form standard), deliberate deviation from published tables

rir_anchor allows coexistence; DB constraint requires rir and rir_anchor populated together
technical_failure is its own axis, not an RIR value
planned_sets.prescribed_rpe is a prescription, not an observation
Brock-authored prescriptions carry his technical-failure anchor; no second convention
Never aggregate prescriptions with observations; compare side by side only
No RPE-based e1RM estimator over technically anchored values; guard test enforces
Forbidden: deriving calibration offset to convert his anchor to table anchor
If finer intensity ever needed, grain is block, never set
Trigger for block intensity is a real analytics question session_rpe cannot answer; until then one number
Do not build block-level intensity capture speculatively
PT/rehab deliberately programmed at ~3-4; effortful feel or burn does not mean mis-prescribed
Binding: low-sRPE analytics must exclude or separately classify rehab-dominant sessions
Rehab-dominant sessions identified by block_type and UseContext rehab tagging, not RPE value
Perception is primary daily instrument; HR is ground truth pairing to see drift
Polar kept but demoted to opportunistic bonus channel (revising same-day retirement)
Polar sync weekly Saturday, not daily; daily job ultrahuman-only
System of record for HR existence is his notes, not the sync job
Binding: no alerting on missing HR or wearable data anywhere; empty pull is silent success
FIT drop-dir import path stays as-is, unmonitored
HR channel precedence: polar_device over manual over note_extraction; device replaces on mismatch
Replace whole HR block, never merge field-by-field
Ambiguous device-to-workout matches skipped in both directions and listed, never guessed
Displaced HR values preserved in workouts.hr_displaced; displacement is silent normal operation
Structured HR fields optional, never required; collapsed optional fieldset in logger
hr_zone_model stored, not assumed; closed vocabulary of four zone models
HR note extraction mechanical, labelled values only, explicit absence respected, zone percentages yield nothing
Calibration pairs session_rpe with HR from any source; 365-day rolling trend window
Calibration is a report Brock reads, never automatic correction of his numbers
TRIMP calibration views remain, dormant by design; emptiness is expected
Whether per-sample HR resumes is a documented unknown; generates no alert
Non-goal: no imputation of modelled or table-derived values
Non-goal: no anchor conversion offset
Non-goal: no auto-correction of his numbers, including the distribution
Non-goal: no backfill of session_rpe onto workouts without a value
Non-goal: no change to how Brock logs; system adapts, notes extracted mechanically
Non-goal: no wearable API work, repair, diagnosis, re-enable or new integrations
Non-goal: no alerting on missing data of any kind
Intensity extraction uses fixed phrase vocabulary; no LLM call
Only phrases stating remaining capacity produce values; empty rir correct, guessed rir a defect
Named phrase classes (motivational, conditional, unquantified, other-set) explicitly produce nothing
Brock binding 2026-09-12: no theater, no forced logging; unprovided means not logged
Section 12 amends sections 1-11; no-imputation extended from values to fields
